description: Invoke a tool this tenant has already published, by its local name -- the same real, metered call as calling it directly by its namespaced name (<namespace>.<name>), for a session that has no way to see its own namespaced tool name yet. Unlike host.tool_test, this counts toward host.usage and appears in host.tool_logs. Pass async: true for a tool that needs more than the call deadline: returns {run_id, status: "queued"} immediately instead of running inline -- see host.runs.get/wait. Pass version to pin the call to one of host.tool_history's versions instead of whichever is current.

args.description: Arguments to pass, validated against the tool's own args_schema.

async.description: Run as a job instead of inline: returns {run_id, status} within ~50ms under the plan's job_max_s deadline; default false.

budget.description: Lowers this call's budget below the plan default: any subset of max_child_calls, max_est_tokens, max_tool_latency_ms, max_wall_ms. A value above the plan's own ceiling is a validation error naming it; see host.runs.get's progress.budget.

max_child_calls.description: Free-plan ceiling 20; pro ceiling 50. Maximum shown is the free floor -- see host.quickstart limits.plan.budget for your plan.

max_est_tokens.description: Free-plan ceiling 200000; pro ceiling 2000000. Maximum shown is the free floor -- see host.quickstart limits.plan.budget for your plan.

max_tool_latency_ms.description: Free-plan ceiling 30000; pro ceiling 120000. Maximum shown is the free floor -- see host.quickstart limits.plan.budget for your plan.

max_wall_ms.description: Free-plan ceiling 60000; pro ceiling 600000. Maximum shown is the free floor -- see host.quickstart limits.plan.budget for your plan.

dry_run.description: Ask instead of call: runs every admission check the real call runs, dispatches nothing, writes no call row, and returns {fits, units, remaining, refusal}; same as host.estimate. Default false.

name.description: Local name of the tool to invoke.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Optional on the connection that ran signup (or host.redeem): that connection is already bound to the tenant it created, so later calls on it need no tenant_key. On a connection with no Authorization: Bearer header and no prior signup, omitting it implicitly signs that connection up as a brand-new tenant and runs this call as it -- see host.whoami's source field. When both a header and this argument are present, the header wins.

version.description: Pin the call to this version instead of whichever is current; see host.tool_history. An unknown version is an argument error.

name: host.tool_call
